# Mirror Trade - Copy Top Prediction Market Traders

## About
Mirror Trade is a mobile app for Kalshi and Polymarket traders. Follow the best-performing prediction market traders, automatically copy their portfolios, and track your P&L in real time. For pro traders, it's a way to monetize the research you're already doing by building a following and earning from your positions.

## Platform
- iOS (iPhone & iPad)
- Android
- Available on the App Store and Google Play

## Key Features
- **Discover Strategists**: Browse traders ranked by win rate, ROI, and streaks. Every stat is verified from public Kalshi profiles.
- **One-Tap Copy Trading**: Set a budget, tap follow, and every new position is automatically mirrored in your portfolio.
- **Live P&L Tracking**: Watch your portfolio update in real time with live Kalshi price feeds.
- **Whale Alerts & Trade Feed**: See every position from traders you follow in a real-time feed with push notifications.
- **Market Discovery**: Browse and search thousands of Kalshi and Polymarket markets across sports, politics, and economics.
- **Become a Strategist**: Post your positions with reasoning, build a public track record, and grow a following.

## How It Works
1. Download Mirror Trade from the App Store or Google Play.
2. Discover top-performing traders and review their stats.
3. Follow traders and set your copy budget.
4. Get notified when they post positions and track your P&L live.

## Target Audience
- Prediction market traders who want to follow and copy top performers
- Kalshi and Polymarket users looking for an edge
- Pro traders who want to monetize their research by building a following
